evidence: No versions-seen/channel-version coverage anywhere on tenanos-wave/integration: `git grep -in 'versionsSeen|versions-seen|versions_seen' tenanos-wave/integration -- src/tenanos/` returns zero hits.

P-20260923-103's AttemptCheckpoint {attempt_id, seq, kind, payload} is an attempt-local resume-point with a write gate (validateCheckpoint monotonic seq); it defines no record schema, no channel version vectors, no versions-seen lineage, and no payload-ref discipline.
Proposal scope is distinct and sound: LangGraph checkpoint shape re-keyed to PING Run/step (monotonic checkpoint_id, step_id, values as payload refs, channel_versions, versions_seen).

Reference implementation: impl/P-20260923-005/schema.ts + __tests__/schema.test.ts — tsc strict clean, 16/16 jest tests pass. Core properties proved: (1) no-inline-secrets — any non-{$ref} channel value throws CheckpointSchemaError; (2) checkpoint_id monotonicity gate; (3) versions_seen lineage cover (a checkpoint that forgets a derived version is rejected); (4) canonicalJson key-order-stable for hash-stable lineage.
notes: Seam at integration: this module owns the checkpoint RECORD SHAPE + validation only. 103 keeps the write discipline (validateCheckpoint seq gate, fenced INSERT, zombie-attempt discipline); 103's AttemptCheckpoint.seq is the attempt-local instance of this schema's checkpoint_id monotonicity. 002 keeps run/step identity issuance; run_id/step_id here are foreign keys. Suggested target: src/tenanos/checkpoint/schema.ts. No repo commits made by this worker; reference impl only.

overlaps.relation: complementary, not duplicate: 103 owns checkpoint WRITE discipline (monotonic seq gate, fenced INSERT); 005 owns the checkpoint RECORD schema (versions, versions-seen lineage, payload-ref rule). Documented as a seam in the module header.
